headlines.text: Between hope and fear: Yemenis react to Houthi blockade on Saudi Arabia. Yemenis fear a maritime embargo on Saudi Arabia could reignite war, deepen shortages and worsen hunger.
Will the war on Iran affect ASEAN’s efforts to tackle regional issues?. Renewed fighting between the US and Iran has overshadowed the ASEAN gathering in Manila.
Thousands forced to evacuate as wildfires sweep across southern France. Thousands of people are being evacuated from areas of southern France as firefighters battle huge wildfires.
US attacks Iran for 12th night as the House approves defence spending. Strikes from the US on Iran are raining down for the 12th night in a row.
Saudi Arabia and US agree to landmark nuclear deal for civilian purposes. The US and Saudi Arabia have agreed to a civilian nuclear deal allowing Riyadh to build nuclear reactors.
Indian police accused of using pellet guns in crackdown on India’s protests. Videos emerge showing police using pellet guns on protesters India’s student protest movement.
Israel building earthen barrier in Gaza to entrench division of the enclave. The construction of the barrier has fuelled Palestinian fears that most of Gaza will never be relinquished by Israel.
Guyana ferry disaster: families demand answers as around 100 feared dead. Officials say 76 of the roughly 179 people believed to have been aboard survived, and 53 bodies have been found so far.
Jailed opposition leader Ghannouchi faints in Tunisian prison due to heat. The incident was witnessed by the daughter of Ahmed Nejib Chebbi, another prominent political prisoner.
Five soldiers killed in southern Thailand checkpoint attack. The assault in Narathiwat comes a day after a car bombing elsewhere in the province wounded a police officer.
Calls for Moroccan rapper’s release outside a Casablanca court. Protesters gathered outside a court in Casablanca, Morocco to demand the release of Moroccan rapper Mehdi El Youbi.
Armed attackers kill more than 20 in northwest Nigeria. The attacks reflect a surge in violence as armed gangs continue raiding villages in northwest and central Nigeria.
In Gaza, a long path to recovery for one woman who lost eye, and daughter. Psychological wounds compound Najwa's physical injuries after losing her daughter in an Israeli air strike.
Abderrahim Fakir’s death has reignited Italy’s police accountability debate. A Moroccan-born man’s death in Bologna has prompted anger and renewed scrutiny of Italy’s policing and legal reforms.
Spain and France battle raging wildfires, face high risk of more. A wildfire in Spain's Guadalajara region has burned 32,000 hectares, in one of the country's largest recorded blazes.

Nicaragua's parliament plans to eliminate elections to codify President Ortega's declaration. Nicaragua's congress moves to abolish elections after President Daniel Ortega declared no more elections, drawing condemnation from the international community.

Border K9 sniffs out 99 pounds of prohibited meat, plants and monitor lizard in suitcase from Thailand. K9 Maisy discovered 50 pounds of raw meat, mangoes and 16 pounds of Bengal monitor lizard in luggage from Thailand, prompting a wildlife seizure.

Watch: Missouri suspect dives headfirst off bridge in wild bid to evade deputies. Video captures a Missouri man sprinting across a bridge and diving headfirst into Table Rock Lake after leading Stone County deputies on a chase.

Caitlin Clark proves there's no NBA 2K27 cover curse as Fever set franchise scoring record. Caitlin Clark posted 27 points and 11 assists as the Indiana Fever set a franchise scoring record in a 123-88 blowout of the Connecticut Sun.

Boston Red Sox 15-game winning streak finally comes to an end, one short of setting franchise record. The Boston Red Sox tied a franchise record with 15 consecutive wins, turning a last-place AL East team into a legitimate MLB postseason contender.

Piker tells Mamdani to ‘shut the f--- up’ over cautious messaging, claims mayor needs to be more 'bold'. Hasan Piker told Zohran Mamdani to "shut the f--- up" and urged progressives to be bolder and less optics-driven in a podcast with Mehdi Hasan.

Liberty's Sabrina Ionescu addresses absence from WNBA 3-point contest: 'Never officially got invited'. Sabrina Ionescu says she was never officially invited to the WNBA 3-point contest, contradicting reports she declined to participate in All-Star weekend.

Bear caught on camera perched atop New Mexico utility pole before reportedly suffering fatal electrocution. Viral video shows a bear perched atop a utility pole along a rural New Mexico highway, panting and struggling to keep its balance on the precarious perch.

Teachers who once dated and share child arrested after classroom argument spiraled into violence: police. Both teachers at The SEED School of Miami face domestic violence battery charges after an alleged assault and pepper spray attack on school property.

Sophie Cunningham doubles down ahead of Sun game after ESPN profile stirs controversy: 'I said what I said'. Sophie Cunningham told WNBA reporters she refuses to back down on protecting women's sports, citing Title IX and her belief in safeguarding girls.

Jack Smith hit with criminal referral as GOP moves testimony fight toward prosecution. Jim Jordan issued a criminal referral against Jack Smith, accusing him of making false statements to Congress about accessing lawmakers' text messages.

Trump salutes 'great heroes' as he attends dignified transfer of US service members killed in Jordan, Iraq. President Donald Trump said ahead of a dignified transfer ceremony that the four U.S. service members killed in action overseas were "great heroes."

Survivor of Hamas terror attack in Israel slams Mamdani over 'dangerous' video about Netanyahu. Mazal Tazazo said a video NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani released calling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a "war criminal" is "dangerous."

Oakland baseball team will host 'historic' 'family-friendly' marijuana-themed game day. The Oakland Ballers will rebrand as the "Oaksterdam Blazers" for what they call professional baseball's first cannabis game night on Grateful Dead Night.

Far-left 'Squad' Dems mix up Jewish colleagues in botched attack — then get burned by their own votes. Moderate Dem Rep. Josh Gottheimer tangled online with far-left “Squad" members after Rep. Summer Lee appeared to confuse him with Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro.
